newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton market closed for Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton market closed for Christmas.

text.p: The Bombay cotton market was closed for Christmas on Wednesday. It reopens on Thursday.
On Tuesday, cotton prices firmed, cheered by lower crop estimates announced by the official Cotton Advisory Board.
The board, at a meeting late on Monday, estimated the new crop for the 1996-97 season (October/September) at 15.50 million bales (170 kg each) compared to 16.15 million in the previous season.
In spot, Bengal desi was steady at 805/840 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and Punjab sawginned at 1,360/1,615 rupees.
